_comment: Opt-in LLM summarization, configured via the 'orcarouter' provider preset.
OFF by default: this stage only runs because BOTH the top-level llm block exists AND compression.default.llmSummary is true below.
When enabled, over-budget, non-security-sensitive tool outputs are sent to the configured endpoint - and nothing else, nowhere else. Do not enable if that is not acceptable for your data.

apiKey is omitted here: with a provider preset it defaults to the ORCAROUTER_API_KEY environment variable. To override, add an explicit apiKey line referencing a different environment variable (see config.llm-generic.json for that syntax).
model 'orcarouter/free' is their difficulty-routed free tier; free-tier models cost nothing. Full catalog: https://orcarouter.ai/models
Any OpenAI-compatible provider works identically - see config.llm-generic.json.
